title: 49 Swahili Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Swahili for Beginners (Doctor & Pharmacy)
description:
Learn 49 essential Swahili phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Swahili #LearnSwahili #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in Kiswahili, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Swahili with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 49 real-life phrases
- Kiswahili audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Doctor & Pharmacy · Daktari na Dawa
1:26  Daily Routine · Ratiba ya Kila Siku
2:54  Wisdom · Hekima
4:11  Phone Calls & Messages · Simu na Ujumbe
5:33  Dating & Romance · Uchumba na Mapenzi
6:42  Family & Home · Familia na Nyumbani
7:56  Inspiration · Msukumo
9:21  Self Improvement · Kujiboresha

PHRASE LIST

DOCTOR & PHARMACY · Daktari na Dawa
• I feel dizzy, can I be checked? - Ninazimia kidogo, naomba mniangaliwe.  [Nin-a-zimi-a KIDOGO, naomba mniangaliwe.]
• Do you offer same-day blood tests? - Mna vipimo vya damu vya siku ya leo?  [Mn-a VI-pi-mo vya DU-a vya SI-ku ya LEO?]
• I need a painkiller for back pain. - Naomba dawa ya kupunguza maumivu ya mgongo.  [Na-omba DA-wa ya ku-PU-punguza MA-u-mivu ya MGO-NGO.]
• Is this medicine safe during pregnancy? - Dawa hii ni salama nikikabiliwa na ujauzito?  [DA-wa hii ni SA-la-ma ni-ki-ka-bi-li-wa na u-ja-UZI-to?]
• Can you tell me the side effects? - Naomba mnieleze madhara ya dawa hii.  [Na-omba mni-e-le-ze MAD-ha-ra ya DA-wa hii.]
• My stomach hurts after taking it. - Tumbo langu linauma nikishaimeza.  [TUM-bo langu li-na-u-ma ni-ki-sha-me-ZA.]

DAILY ROUTINE · Ratiba ya Kila Siku
• I shower, then dry off quickly. - Ninaoga, kisha ninakauka haraka.  [Na in GO-ga, KI-she na in KA-uka HA-ra-ka.]
• I choose my clothes and get dressed. - Ninaamua mavazi, kisha ninaanza kuvaa.  [Na na-u-a mu-VA-zi, kisha na an-SA ku-VA-a.]
• I brush my teeth and spit. - Na piga mswaki, kisha natema.  [Na PI-ga em-SWA-ki, kisha na TE-ma.]
• I leave home with my keys. - Ninaondoka nyumbani nikiwa na funguo.  [Na na-ON-dO-ka NYU-mba-ni nki-wa na FUNGU-o.]
• I stop for a quick coffee run. - Ninasimama kwa kahawa ya haraka.  [Na na-SI-mama kwa ka-HA-wa ya ha-RA-ka.]
• I check the weather before heading out. - Ninakagua hali ya hewa kabla sijatoka.  [Na na-KA-ga ha-li ya HE-wa ka-bla si-ja-TO-ka.]
• I start my work with a plan. - Naanza kazi kwa kupanga hatua.  [Na-AN-za KA-zi kwa PAN-ga nJU-ta.]

WISDOM · Hekima
• Let your yes be thoughtful. - Sema ndiyo kwa kufikiri kwanza.  [SEMA nYO kwa kuFIKIri KWA kwanza.]
• Walk away from drama, kindly. - Tembea mbali na migogoro, kwa heshima.  [TEMBEA mBALI na MIgoGoro, kwa HEshiMA.]
• Stop spending on what fades. - Acha kutumia kwenye vitu vinavyopotea.  [Acha kuTUMIa kwenye VItu viNAvyOPOTea.]
• Guard your time like your money. - Linda muda wako kama pesa yako.  [LINda MUda waKO kaMA PEsa yaKO.]
• Be honest, but keep it gentle. - Sema ukweli, lakini kwa upole.  [SEma UKWELi, LAkinI kwa uPOLE.]
• Before judging, ask what they need. - Kabla ya kuhukumu, uliza wanachohitaji.  [KABla ya kuHUmu, uLIZA waNACHoHITaji.]

PHONE CALLS & MESSAGES · Simu na Ujumbe
• Calling to confirm our meeting time. - Napiga simu ili kuthibitisha saa ya mkutano wetu.  [Na-PI-ga SI-mu i-li ku-THA-biTISH-a sa-a ya MU-ku-Ta we-tu.]
• Hi, I sent a message earlier. - Habari, niliwatumia ujumbe mapema.  [HA-ba-ri, ni-li-wa-TU-ma ujum-be ma-PE-ma.]
• Can we talk now, for a sec? - Tunaweza kuzungumza sasa hivi, kwa muda mfupi?  [Tu-na-we-za ku-ZUNGUM-ZA sa-sa hi-vi, kwa MU-da MFU-pi.]
• I’m running late, sorry, can you wait? - Na-chelewa kidogo, samahani, utaweza kusubiri?  [Na-che-LA-wa ki-di-go, sa-ma-ha-ni, u-ta-we-za ku-su-BI-ri?]
• Please text me the address. - Tafadhali nitumie ujumbe wa anwani.  [Ta-fa-DHI-li ni-tu-MI-e ujum-be wa aN-wa-ni.]
• I need a quick update, please. - Nahitaji taarifa fupi, tafadhali.  [Ni-na-HI-ja ta-a-RAi-fa-FU-pi, ta-fa-DHI-li.]

DATING & ROMANCE · Uchumba na Mapenzi
• You look amazing tonight - Unaonekana mzuri sana usiku wa leo,  [U-na-on-ROOT-ka mzuri SA-na usi-ku wa LEO,]
• How was your day, really? - Siku yako iliendaje, kweli?  [Si-ku ya-ko i-li-en-DA-je, KWA-li?]
• Can I call you later? - Naweza kukupigia simu baadaye?  [Na-wee za ku-ku-pi-ya SI-mu ba-a-da-ye?]
• What are you thinking right now? - Unawaza nini sasa hivi?  [U-na-wa-za NI-ni SA-sa hi-vi?]
• I missed you, so much - Nilikukosa sana,  [Ni-li-ku-KO-sa SA-na,]
• Let’s take a slow walk together - Tuende matembezi taratibu pamoja,  [Tu-en-de ma-te-me-za TARA-tibu pa-moj-a,]

FAMILY & HOME · Familia na Nyumbani
• Dinner’s ready, come help please. - Mlo uko tayari, njoo usaidie tafadhali.  [mlo uko TA-arI, njoo u-saIDIE ta-fa-dhaLI.]
